{{Otheruses|Booster}}
[[File:Qualdex_Halcyon_Starfighter_Booster.png|thumb|right|220px|A [[Quadex/Legends|Qualdex]] "[[Halcyon (booster)|Halcyon]]" starfighter booster]]
A '''booster''' was a type of [[Starship/Legends|starship]] component. This device allocated a large part of the energy produced by the [[Reactor/Legends|reactor]] of the ship to the [[Engine/Legends|engine]] in order to provide an extra, temporary boost of speed. Boosters were commonly embedded in [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] to give an advantage in [[Starfighter combat/Legends|dogfighting]] or to get away overhastily.<ref name="SWG:JtL">''[[Star Wars Galaxies: Jump to Lightspeed]]''</ref>
